cards.title: Remainder by 10
cards.body: Divide a whole number by 10 and the remainder is its last digit. `%` gives you that remainder.

hi.title: 10 se remainder
hi.body: Kisi whole number ko 10 se divide karo, toh remainder uska last digit hota hai. `%` aapko wahi remainder deta hai.

cards.title: Dropping the last digit
cards.body: `// 10` does the opposite: it removes the last digit.

hi.title: Last digit hatana
hi.body: `// 10` ulta kaam karta hai: yeh last digit hata deta hai.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: For 427 it should print 7, but it prints 42. Tap the bug.

bug.fix: `n // 10` drops the last digit. The remainder, `n % 10`, is the last digit.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: 427 ke liye isse 7 print karna chahiye, par yeh 42 print karta hai. Bug par tap karo.
hi.fix: `n // 10` last digit hata deta hai. Remainder, yaani `n % 10`, hi last digit hai.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: 2049 divided by 10 leaves 9 over, and that is the last digit.

hi.question: Yeh kya print karega?
hi.explanation: 2049 ko 10 se divide karne par 9 bachta hai, aur wahi last digit hai.

exercise.prompt: Read a whole number (0 or more) and print its last digit. Hint: the remainder after dividing by 10 is the last digit.
exercise.promptHi: Ek whole number padho (0 ya usse bada) aur uska last digit print karo. Hint: 10 se divide karne ke baad ka remainder hi last digit hai.
